units.source_text: “是么，做了三十家的份儿，还要增加吗？

en.t: Really? You have made enough for thirty households, and you still need more?

units.source_text: 这村庄不到五十户人家，

en.t: There are fewer than fifty households in this village,

units.source_text: 像你这样的，也会收到各方面的贺礼吗？”

en.t: would someone like you also receive congratulatory gifts from all around?
